Hi Rachel / team —

Thanks for the fast response and for looping in Karthik and Laura. We received the vendor form and sample invoice you uploaded to the Drive link — looks good. A few clarifications from AP before we finalize:

- PO matching: we prioritize PO_NUMBER first and then EXTERNAL_REFERENCE. Please ensure the PDF shows PO_NUMBER clearly; line-level PO references help matching when invoices include multiple POs.
- EDI: Your sample 810 matched our schema for the most part; we noted your TAX segment does not include the "REVERSE_CHARGE" qualifier. For EU reverse charge please include the note: "Reverse charge — Article 194 VAT Directive" in the TAX_NOTE element. Our parser will accept both PDF and EDI; for automation choose EDI 810 if you're comfortable.
- Multi-entity: ProcureX prefers a single supplier master record with remit IDs — that is the cleaner approach. We will create Redwood Inference, Inc as the master supplier and add remit-to subrecords for the EU legal entity.
- Test PO: I created a test supplier record this morning (supplier ID PX-44988) and pushed two test POs to the portal: PO_NUMBER 90010012 (EUR) and 90010013 (GBP). Those are non-payable test POs you can use to validate matching.
- Payment terms: Net45 is standard for ProcureX. If you need Net30 for POC please flag it and we can request an exception internally (Mats is on cc to help escalate).

Next steps from ProcureX:
1) Complete the small sign-off in the supplier portal (link: https://procurex.com/supplier-portal/register) and upload your signed vendor form (we accepted the PDF you uploaded to Drive).
2) If using EDI, send test 810s to edi-test@procurex.com and include a header referencing PX-44988. We'll return 997/ACK messages within 2 hours of receipt.
3) Once you confirm the invoice samples are accepted, we'll transition the test POs to live status and include Redwood in our scheduled pay runs.

Attachments: ProcureX_vendor_packet_v1.pdf (our onboarding packet), procurex_edi_spec_v2.xml

Welcome aboard — happy to help if you need any mapping tweaks.

Best,
